# cli-agent-mode

> Make any commander.js CLI usable by AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, opencode) without breaking it for humans: `--json` output envelopes, machine-readable errors with a `suggestion`, a `describe` command that returns the whole CLI schema in one call, auto-detection of agents, and stable exit codes. Zero dependencies, ESM + CJS, Node 22+, commander 12–15.

Use it when: a Node.js CLI built with commander should be driven by AI agents or scripts (CI, jq) — instead of hand-rolling `if (opts.json)` in every command.

## Install and wire up

```ts
import { Command } from 'commander';
import { AgentError, agentMode, run } from 'cli-agent-mode';

const program = agentMode(new Command('mycli'));      // call before defining subcommands
program
  .command('deploy')
  .argument('<env>')
  .option('--dry-run')
  .action(async (env, opts) => {
    if (env !== 'prod') throw new AgentError('ENV_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown env "${env}"`, { suggestion: 'Use: prod.' });
    return { env, url: 'https://prod.example.com' };   // return data, don't print it
  });
await run(program);                                    // instead of program.parse()
```

## Output contract

- Success: stdout = `{"ok":true,"data":<action return value>}`, exit 0.
- Error: stdout = `{"ok":false,"error":{"code","message","suggestion?","details?"}}`, exit 1 (runtime) or 2 (usage).
- Usage error codes: UNKNOWN_OPTION, UNKNOWN_COMMAND, MISSING_ARGUMENT, MISSING_OPTION_VALUE, MISSING_REQUIRED_OPTION, INVALID_ARGUMENT, EXCESS_ARGUMENTS, CONFLICTING_OPTIONS, MISSING_COMMAND, USAGE_ERROR; unexpected exceptions: INTERNAL_ERROR.
- `mycli describe [command...] --json` and `mycli <cmd> --help --json` return a compact schema: `{name, description, usage, arguments[], options[{flags, description, required?, default?, choices?}], commands[]}`.
- JSON mode turns on with `--json`, `CLI_AGENT_MODE=json`, or an auto-detected agent; `CLI_AGENT_MODE=human` forces text.
- In JSON mode `console.log` inside actions goes to stderr; stdout holds only the envelope.

## API

- `agentMode(program, { autoDetect?, describeCommand?, formatHuman? })` — wraps a commander program; lets `.action()` return a result.
- `run(program, { args?, json?, env?, stdout?, stderr?, setExitCode? })` → `{ mode, exitCode, envelope }`.
- `new AgentError(code, message, { suggestion?, details?, exitCode? })`.
- `describeCommand(cmd)`, `findCommand(root, path)`, `detectAgent(env?)`, `EXIT`.
